title: I wept alone
html_source:
Internal narrative but it is very difficult not to interpret this as autobiographical given the sentence structure. A message from Joyce similar to A man of genius makes no mistakes. His errors are volitional and are the portals of discovery in a few lines time.

THE DEAD :

RIP May Joyce
Ellmann, page 136 : ‘ May Joyce died on August 13, 1903, at the early age of fouty four.’
Joyce was beginning the short stories which constitute Dubliners at the time. John Joyce, jj’s father was a brutal alcoholic whose slip down the salary scales and pensioned redundancy led to the family’s move into low income areas of Dublin. As May Joyce was dying, he drunkenly, attempted to strangle her repeating an attack of 1895 during which he grabbed her throat and shouted ‘Now, by God, is the time to finish it’. (Ellmann, R. James Joyce, p41).
